tagline.en: Ohio's second turnpike, built free instead
tagline.zh: 俄亥俄的第二条收费公路，最终改建成了免费路

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.en: I-64 and I-65 in Louisville, Kentucky
start.zh: 肯塔基州路易斯维尔，与 I-64、I-65 相接

end.zh: 俄亥俄州克利夫兰，与 I-90 相接

en: I-71 is the diagonal that holds Ohio together. It runs southwest to northeast from Louisville through Cincinnati, Columbus and Cleveland, linking the three largest cities in the state and the largest city in Kentucky, and it carries a great deal of the traffic that used to move on US 42 and Ohio 3.

The road is unusually plain between the cities — long straight stretches through farmland, with the longest tangent in Ohio north of Cincinnati — and unusually complicated inside them. At its southern end it shares the Brent Spence Bridge with I-75 across the Ohio River; in Cincinnati it passes under Lytle Park in a tunnel and clings to the hillside below Mount Adams; in Columbus it shares the downtown innerbelt with I-70 in an arrangement that has been under reconstruction for years.

None of this was the original plan. The corridor was laid out in the early 1950s as a second Ohio toll road, to be called State Route 1 and to run from Cincinnati northeast to Conneaut and on to the New York Thruway.
zh: I-71 是把俄亥俄串起来的那条对角线。它自西南向东北，从路易斯维尔经辛辛那提、哥伦布直到克利夫兰，把该州最大的三座城市与肯塔基最大的城市连在一起，承接了原先走 US 42 和俄亥俄 3 号州道的大量交通。
城市之间，这条路平淡得有些反常——穿过农田的长直线路段，其中辛辛那提以北那一段是俄亥俄境内最长的直线；而进了城，它又复杂得反常。南端，它与 I-75 共用跨越俄亥俄河的布伦特·斯彭斯大桥；在辛辛那提，它从莱特尔公园下方以隧道穿过，并贴着亚当斯山下的坡地而行；在哥伦布，它与 I-70 共用市中心内环，这一段已经改建多年。
这些都不是最初的计划。这条走廊在 1950 年代初的设计，是作为俄亥俄的第二条收费公路，编号为 1 号州道，自辛辛那提东北行至康尼奥特，再接上纽约州快速干道。

en: State Route 1 was being planned as a toll road when the Federal-Aid Highway Act of 1956 changed the arithmetic. With ninety per cent federal money available for a free highway, Ohio converted the project and began opening sections in 1959. Because the Interstate numbering had not yet been applied, the completed pieces were signed both as SR 1 and with their new Interstate numbers, and existing two- and four-lane highways were signed as SR 1 to fill the gaps.

The Interstate number was established in Ohio in 1962, and the redundant SR 1 shields came down in 1966. Kentucky built its section between November 1965 and July 1969. Ohio finished in 1975, the last links being through Cincinnati, where a landslide at the base of Mount Adams in 1973 and another the following year forced the design and construction of the first post-tensioned retaining wall in the country.
Columbus took longer to settle. I-71 originally ran around the west and north sides of downtown; that alignment was given up in 1976 and the number moved to the eastern innerbelt it uses today.
zh: 1 号州道正按收费公路规划时，1956 年《联邦公路法》改变了账本。既然免费公路可以拿到九成联邦资金，俄亥俄便把项目改了性质，并于 1959 年起分段通车。由于州际公路编号尚未实施，已建成的路段同时挂 SR 1 和新的州际公路编号，既有的双车道、四车道公路也被标为 SR 1 以填补空隙。
州际公路编号 1962 年在俄亥俄确立，多余的 SR 1 标志 1966 年撤下。肯塔基段建于 1965 年 11 月至 1969 年 7 月。俄亥俄 1975 年完工，最后几处衔接位于辛辛那提——1973 年亚当斯山山脚的一次滑坡和次年的又一次滑坡，迫使工程设计并建造了全美第一面后张法挡土墙。
哥伦布的格局定得更晚。I-71 最初绕市中心西侧和北侧而行；这条线位 1976 年被放弃，编号移到了它今天所走的东侧内环上。

en: There is no construction total for I-71 as a route. What is documented is the cost of keeping it adequate: Ohio spent about fifteen years widening the whole length between Columbus and Cleveland from four lanes to six, finishing in 2014, and the two halves of that programme were separately costed.

The bigger liability sits at the other end. I-71 shares the Brent Spence Bridge with I-75 at Cincinnati, a double-deck cantilever span that carries roughly twice the traffic it was designed for. Its decks were reconfigured in the 1980s to squeeze in an extra lane in each direction by narrowing the lanes and all but eliminating the shoulders, and replacing the crossing has been a federal priority project for years.
zh: I-71 作为一条路线没有建设总造价。有据可查的是维持其通行能力的花费：俄亥俄用了大约十五年，把哥伦布至克利夫兰全段由四车道拓宽为六车道，2014 年完工，该计划的前后两部分各自单独计价。
更大的包袱在另一端。I-71 在辛辛那提与 I-75 共用布伦特·斯彭斯大桥，那是一座双层悬臂桥，承载的车流大约是设计值的两倍。1980 年代，桥面通过缩窄车道、几乎取消路肩的方式重新划线，每个方向硬挤出一条车道；多年来，替换这一跨河通道一直是联邦层面的重点项目。

why.en: No public figure exists. Ohio and Kentucky built the route between 1959 and 1975 under a federal-aid programme whose cost records were organised by state and fiscal year, and the Ohio sections were originally let as a state toll-road project before being converted.
why.zh: 无公开数据。俄亥俄与肯塔基于 1959 至 1975 年间建成本路线，所属联邦补助计划的造价记录按州和财政年度组织；俄亥俄路段最初还是作为州属收费公路项目发包的，之后才改变性质。

value.en: 324.46 miles — 246.74 in Ohio and 77.72 in Kentucky
value.zh: 324.46 英里——俄亥俄州 246.74 英里，肯塔基州 77.72 英里

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

label.zh: 哥伦布至克利夫兰段拓宽

value.en: $559.4 million for 118 miles completed in 2009, and $144 million for the final 25 miles in Morrow and Richland counties completed in 2014
value.zh: 2009 年完工的 118 英里耗资 5.594 亿美元；2014 年完工的莫罗县与里奇兰县最后 25 英里耗资 1.44 亿美元

figures.source: Mansfield News Journal, reporting Ohio Department of Transportation figures, 13 October 2014

why.en: No agency publishes a route-wide figure. Counts are collected per segment by the Ohio Department of Transportation and the Kentucky Transportation Cabinet, and volumes range from rural farmland sections to the downtown Columbus innerbelt.
why.zh: 没有机构发布全线数字。交通量由俄亥俄州交通部与肯塔基州交通厅按路段采集，流量从农田乡村路段到哥伦布市中心内环相差悬殊。

label.zh: 辛辛那提，布伦特·斯彭斯大桥

value.en: About 160,000 vehicles a day on the shared I-71/I-75 crossing, against a design load of roughly 80,000
value.zh: I-71 与 I-75 共用的跨河段日均约 160,000 辆，而设计承载量约为 80,000 辆

trafficFigures.source: Ohio Department of Transportation, Brent Spence Bridge Corridor grant announcement, 2022

timeline.en: The Federal-Aid Highway Act converts Ohio's planned second turnpike, State Route 1, into a free Interstate project.
timeline.zh: 《联邦公路法》把俄亥俄规划中的第二条收费公路——1 号州道——改为免费的州际公路项目。

timeline.en: The first sections open, signed both as SR 1 and with their new Interstate numbers.
timeline.zh: 首批路段通车，同时挂 SR 1 与新的州际公路编号。

timeline.en: The I-71 designation is established in Ohio; the redundant SR 1 shields come down in 1966.
timeline.zh: I-71 编号在俄亥俄确立；多余的 SR 1 标志于 1966 年撤下。

timeline.en: Kentucky completes its section in July, four years after starting.
timeline.zh: 肯塔基州于 7 月完成本州路段，距开工四年。

timeline.en: The last Ohio links open through Cincinnati, completing the route from Louisville to Cleveland.
timeline.zh: 俄亥俄最后几段在辛辛那提通车，路易斯维尔至克利夫兰全线贯通。

timeline.en: I-71 is moved off the west and north legs of the Columbus innerbelt onto its present eastern alignment.
timeline.zh: I-71 从哥伦布内环的西段与北段迁出，改走今日的东侧线位。

timeline.en: Ohio finishes widening the last four-lane stretch between Columbus and Cleveland, ending a programme of about fifteen years.
timeline.zh: 俄亥俄完成哥伦布至克利夫兰之间最后一段四车道的拓宽，结束了历时约十五年的计划。
